    Deployments

    Clone a GitHub repo onto a VPS, write a .env from your variables, and run docker compose up -d --build. 

    
            
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
            
    
              
    Migrate a Compose stack
    
              
    
                Moves a docker-compose stack from one VPS to another: compose file,
                env files, and named volumes. The source is never shut down by
                the app — you'll do that yourself after verifying the target.
              
    
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
    
                Required when the SSH user can't write to the target compose dir,
                or when docker isn't accessible without sudo. Assumes passwordless
                sudo (or root) — if sudo is refused, the error is shown as-is.
              
    
              
    
                
              
    
              
    
            
    

            
            
    
              
    Multiple stacks found
    
              
    
                This folder has no compose file of its own, but its subdirectories do.
                Pick which stacks to migrate — each goes to
                /<name> on the target.

    Scheduled backups
    
                  
    
                    Back up volumes, database dumps and compose files to an S3 bucket with
                    restic, on a cron schedule that runs on the VPS itself.

    Remove a stack
    
              
    
                Tears down a docker-compose stack on this VPS: docker compose down,
                and optionally its named volumes, images, and the stack directory. External
                volumes and networks are left untouched.
